title: How to connect this webhook
text: Orch8 has no webhook-subscription API: outbound webhooks are configured on the engine. Copy the webhook URL Make generated and add it to ORCH8_WEBHOOK_URLS (comma-separated) or [engine.webhooks].urls in orch8.toml, then restart the engine. Every configured URL receives every event for every tenant; use the event filter on the webhook and a Make filter on tenant if you share an engine.
